sheet_from: Data/World11/TileGrass01.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under an ic_ prefix. World11 ships no other tile sheet, yet its slots 1 and 7-10 (0.3% of the tiles) name five: each is parked on a copy of TileGrass01 under its own name (ic_tilegrass02, ic_tilerock01-04), as Atlans parked its slot 5, because the ground pairs every surface by its sheet's name. docs/icarus-port.md.
slot_note: Built and never drawn. MuMain skips RenderTerrain on Icarus (MainScene.cpp:463), and the world json's `sky` (terrain.py SKY_BY_MAP) keeps this ground out of every pass: it is here because index.py lists a world by its built ground, and the heights, grid and painted light under it are read for every foot, drop and click. A flat plane at 2.85 m, 10.7% walkable, no safe tile.
material_note: Unseen; any material serves. sand, as the plainest.
